Subject: SIG intake — prefilling approach & clarifying HIPAA/GDPR scope

Hi Leah / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a suggested path for the security questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ/custom):

1) What we heard from your side:
- Primary concern: HIPAA applicability for patient PII and EU residency for a subset of analytics.
- You prefer Redwood to prefill the SIG where possible and attach our SOC2 summary to speed review.

2) Clarifying questions (so we can decide SIG vs custom mapping):
- SOC 2: Can you confirm whether your procurement/legal team requires a SOC 2 Type II report dated within the last 12 months (or is a SOC 2 summary + SOC 2 attestation link sufficient)?
- Data residency: Which EU country is the data residency requirement for (if any)? Is it a hard residency requirement or a contractual/data processing appendix matter?
- HIPAA: Do you need a BAA drafted and signed at contract stage, or will you accept a statement of encryption, access controls, and allowed processing operations before the BAA?
- SIG vs CAIQ: For cloud vendor hygiene do you want the full SIG questionnaire prefilling or would a CAIQ + a short custom appendix for HIPAA/residency be acceptable?

3) Proposed next steps:
- I can attach a prefill template (see attachment) and a short SOC 2 summary. If you confirm SOC2 acceptance criteria and residency country, we’ll prefill the SIG and highlight any gaps.
- If Finatra wants to own the form, we can provision the CAIQ only and add the HIPAA appendix. Either way, propose a 30-min kickoff with your security owner and procurement to assign evidence owners.

Attachments: vendor_SIG_prefill_template.xlsx (prefill template to speed completion)

If you can answer the three clarifying bullets above by EOD Tuesday we’ll have a prefilled draft for you to review by close of week.

Thanks —

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the clear recap. Answers inline below so you can proceed: 

- SOC 2: Procurement requires a SOC 2 Type II report within the last 18 months OR a SOC 2 summary accompanied by an attestation link to the auditor’s report. If you can provide both the summary and a link, that should be fine for initial review; legal may request a full report later.

- Data residency: EU residency applies only to analytics datasets used for EU customers. The data residency covenant is country-specific — for now please assume Ireland (IE) as the target. It is a contractual requirement (Data Processing Addendum) rather than a technical block; we will want documentation showing where data is stored and whether it can be constrained to EU regions.

- HIPAA / BAA: We do need a BAA signed before production. For kickoff and risk assessment, we accept a controls statement (encryption at rest/in transit, access controls, logging) but a BAA will be required in parallel with contract negotiations.

- SIG vs CAIQ: For vendors at your scale we prefer a prefilled SIG if you can do it. If there are obvious gaps on HIPAA/residency, we’ll follow up with a short supplementary questionnaire. Prefill the SIG and we’ll escalate any showstoppers.

We can do the 30-min kickoff — Jill (security owner) is OOO until Wed, but Tom can cover initial triage. Proposed times: Wed 10–10:30am ET or Thu 1–1:30pm ET.

Leah
Head of Procurement, Finatra Health
